subject: POC initiation: gap analysis, metrics & access playbook
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: POC initiation: gap analysis, metrics & access playbook

Sam — thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we have a single place to reference. Please confirm or correct anything I’ve gotten wrong.

Key pain & goal (what we heard)
- Brightlane needs sub-second retrieval of historical customer conversations to support an automated triage flow; current infra is high-latency and expensive at scale.
- Primary goal for POC: reduce average token cost by >=40% while keeping top-1 intent accuracy within 3% of your current model.

Proposed POC scope (30 days, sandbox)
- Ingest sample dataset (1M messages / 6 months) — Brightlane to share schema & a 50k-row sample.
- Evaluate Redwood hosted inference + caching profile vs your baseline on 3 live prompt families (triage, summarization, routing).
- Success metrics: avg latency @ p95, token cost per 1k requests, top-1 intent accuracy on benchmark prompt set.

Owners & roles
- Brightlane: Sam Park (product owner, will share data schema & example payloads).
- Redwood: Irene Choi (engagement lead), Ben Carter (commercial lead), Karthik Iyer (ops/infra lead), Marissa Cole (customer success).

Access & security asks
- Brightlane provides S3 sample + minimal dev creds (timeboxed) OR allow us to pull via signed link.
- We requested SOC2 report + network allowlist IPs for the sandbox.

Immediate next steps
1) Sam: share sample schema + sample payload (JSON) and confirm a date for the environment handoff (target week of Jan 25).
2) Redwood: provide POC charter (attached) and security checklist to start provisioning.
3) Schedule a 30-min kickoff with infra owners to walk through ingress and data retention (propose Jan 20).

Attachments: poc-charter-irene-v1.docx (POC scope & deliverables)

Thanks — I’ll loop in Karthik and Marissa to get ops started once you confirm the sample data details.

—
Irene Choi
Engagement Lead, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Irene — this looks great, thanks for the clear summary. Confirming the high-level items and adding a couple of small clarifications: 

- Dataset: we'll export a 50k-row sample (anonymized) today and a separate 1M-row truncated export for the POC. The sample will be in the schema attached (brightlane-sample-schema.json).
- Success metrics: we agree on cost reduction target and want to add a secondary metric — median inference time for short prompts (<128 tokens).
- Security: we can provide a SOC2 Type II report and will create a time-limited IAM role with read-only S3 access for the dev environment.

Proposed kickoff: Jan 25 for environment handoff + baseline run. For the Jan 20 technical sync, I can make 10:30–11:00 PT.

Attachment: brightlane-sample-schema.json

Thanks — Sam
